# Stratonovich Waves Driven by Space-Time Gaussian Noise

> Book by Le Chen (Auburn University), version 1.2.0, arXiv:2611.23014, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24342309 (all versions): the second moment of the Stratonovich hyperbolic Anderson model in dimensions one to three, at the scale t^kappa, kappa = (4 - alpha - alpha_0)/(3 - alpha), with a constant given by an explicit variational formula. Developed with an AI research system (Amy); published with its filtered development history. No AI review grade is a proof; the technical chapters have not yet been read in full by a human.
